invoice_by_id.statement: SELECT id, tenant, revision, customer, updated_ms FROM invoice WHERE id = ? LIMIT ?

invoice_update.statement: UPDATE invoice SET revision = ?, customer = ?, updated_ms = ? WHERE id = ?

line_insert.statement: INSERT INTO invoice_line (invoice_id, line_key, sku, qty, position) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

lines_by_invoice.statement: SELECT invoice_id, line_key, sku, qty, position FROM invoice_line WHERE invoice_id = ? ORDER BY position LIMIT ?

membership_lookup.statement: SELECT actor, tenant FROM invoice_membership WHERE actor = ? AND tenant = ? LIMIT ?

replay_insert.statement: INSERT INTO invoice_replay (actor, invoice_id, operation_id, digest, revision, recorded_ms) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

replay_lookup.statement: SELECT actor, invoice_id, operation_id, digest, revision, recorded_ms FROM invoice_replay WHERE actor = ? AND invoice_id = ? AND operation_id = ? LIMIT ?

session_by_token.statement: SELECT token, actor, revoked_ms FROM invoice_session WHERE token = ? LIMIT ?
